node_notes.driver: The portable X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 driver validates the three-PWM configuration and delegates PWM, standby, mode, and fault operations through callbacks. firmware/drivers/x_nucleo_ihm16m1/x_nucleo_ihm16m1.c exposes x_nucleo_ihm16m1_init, x_nucleo_ihm16m1_drive_motor, and x_nucleo_ihm16m1_read_fault.
node_notes.logger: The logger defines LOGI, LOGE, and related macros over printf for application diagnostics. firmware/utils/logger/logger.h routes those messages through the platform _write implementation rather than directly owning a UART.
node_notes.standby: This output controls the STSPIN830 standby state and is set high for disable and low when PWM is enabled. APP_MOTOR_STBY_PORT and APP_MOTOR_STBY_PIN in firmware/configs/app_config.h bind it to PC9.
node_notes.platform: This STM32 HAL adapter configures motor GPIO, TIM1 PWM, USART2, and the portable driver callbacks. firmware/platforms/stm32/motor_platform.c contains HAL_GPIO_WritePin, HAL_GPIO_ReadPin, HAL_TIM_PWM_Init, HAL_TIM_PWM_Start, and HAL_UART_Transmit use.
node_notes.led: The board status LED is asserted during motor_platform_led_on before motor initialization. firmware/configs/app_config.h identifies the active-high NUCLEO-G431RB LED as PA5, and motor_platform.c writes it high with HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.sine: This module stores phase, frequency, and amplitude and produces three phase-shifted duty values. firmware/modules/sine_control/sine_control.c implements sine_control_output and sine_control_update, which feed the motor drive path.
node_notes.fault: This input reports the active-low EN/FAULT state to the safety layer. firmware/platforms/stm32/motor_platform.c reads APP_MOTOR_EN_FAULT_PORT and APP_MOTOR_EN_FAULT_PIN, which are GPIOB and PB12 in app_config.h.
node_notes.mode: This output selects the configured three-input motor interface and is driven low by the PWM mode callback. APP_MOTOR_MODE_PORT and APP_MOTOR_MODE_PIN bind the signal to PC8.
node_notes.sequence: This module tracks boot delay, startup ramp, hold, shutdown ramp, and stopped states using elapsed milliseconds. firmware/modules/motor_sequence/motor_sequence.c is advanced by app_start with APP_MOTOR_CONTROL_PERIOD_MS, which is 10 ms.
node_notes.pwm_pins: These are the three alternate-function PWM outputs declared in APP_MOTOR_PWM_U_PIN, APP_MOTOR_PWM_V_PIN, and APP_MOTOR_PWM_W_PIN. firmware/configs/app_config.h binds them to PA8, PA9, and PA10 with GPIO_AF6_TIM1.
node_notes.app: This is the application coordinator that initializes the control and sequence state, enables the motor, and runs the 10 ms control loop. firmware/app/app.c provides app_start, motor_platform calls, safety checks, and LOGI or LOGE output.
node_notes.watchdog: The independent watchdog is initialized with a HAL configuration and refreshed during both boot delay and motor control. firmware/platforms/stm32/safety_platform.c owns the IWDG handle and calls HAL_IWDG_Init and HAL_IWDG_Refresh.
node_notes.motor: The application configuration identifies the driven load as the GBM2804H-100T motor attached through the X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 and STSPIN830 interface. The three PWM, standby, mode, and fault connections are declared in firmware/configs/app_config.h and consumed by the motor platform.
node_notes.usart2: USART2 is the debug logging transport initialized at 115200 baud. motor_platform.c configures PA2 as TX and PA3 as RX and implements _write with HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.tim1: TIM1 supplies the three PWM channels with APP_MOTOR_PWM_PERIOD_TICKS set to 4000 for the 20 kHz motor PWM configuration. motor_platform.c configures channels 1, 2, and 3 and updates their compare values from the driver callbacks.
node_notes.safety: This platform layer initializes the independent watchdog, reads and latches the motor fault, and disables the motor on failure. firmware/platforms/stm32/safety_platform.c uses HAL_IWDG_Init, HAL_IWDG_Refresh, and motor_platform_read_fault.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot
  participant App as app_start
  participant Safety as safety_platform
  participant MotorSeq as motor_sequence
  participant MotorPlat as motor_platform
  participant Driver as STSPIN830_driver
  participant PWM as TIM1_PWM
  participant Control as sine_control
  participant UART as USART2_UART
  participant Motor as GBM2804H_motor

  Boot->>App: app_start
  App->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_led_on
  MotorPlat->>UART: initialize USART2 on PA2 and PA3
  MotorPlat->>MotorPlat: HAL_GPIO_WritePin PA5 set
  App->>Control: sine_control_init
  App->>MotorSeq: motor_sequence_init
  App->>Safety: safety_platform_init
  Safety->>Safety: HAL_IWDG_Init
  App->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_init
  MotorPlat->>PWM: HAL_TIM_PWM_Init and configure channels
  MotorPlat->>Driver: x_nucleo_ihm16m1_init
  Driver->>MotorPlat: disable PWM, set standby, select three-PWM mode
  loop boot delay every 10 ms
    App->>Safety: safety_platform_watchdog_refresh
    App->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_delay_ms 10
    App->>MotorSeq: motor_sequence_step 10
  end
  App->>Safety: safety_platform_check_fault
  Safety->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_read_fault
  MotorPlat->>Driver: x_nucleo_ihm16m1_read_fault
  alt fault or status error
    App->>Safety: safety_platform_disable
    Safety->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_enable false
    MotorPlat->>PWM: HAL_TIM_PWM_Stop channels 1 to 3
    App->>UART: LOGE fault message
  else clear before enable
    App->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_enable true
    MotorPlat->>PWM: HAL_TIM_PWM_Start channels 1 to 3
    loop motor control every 10 ms until stopped
      App->>Safety: safety_platform_check_fault
      App->>Control: sine_control_set_profile
      App->>Control: sine_control_output
      App->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_drive duty U/V/W
      MotorPlat->>Driver: x_nucleo_ihm16m1_drive_motor
      Driver->>PWM: set TIM1 compare values
      PWM->>Motor: three-phase PWM on PA8, PA9, PA10
      alt fault or drive error
        App->>Safety: safety_platform_disable
        Safety->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_enable false
        App->>UART: LOGE sinusoidal control stopped
      else control continues
        App->>Control: sine_control_update 10 ms
        App->>Safety: safety_platform_watchdog_refresh
        App->>MotorSeq: motor_sequence_step 10 ms
      end
    end
    App->>Safety: safety_platform_disable
    Safety->>MotorPlat: motor_platform_enable false
    App->>UART: LOGI rotation complete
  end
